$comment: Lives at docs/delix/delix.json in the project root. Hooks and skills read it.
$comment_test_command: The Stop gate runs only this command; include the unit tests that can run locally (if it is only build/lint, the Stop gate lets logic errors through, pilot T004). The full suite and the remote-environment run belong to the card's 'Verification command', run by the orchestrator in the deterministic gate.
$comment_verify: /delix:verify (card-less verification, K43) remote isolated unit test. Placeholders: {name} verification name, {dir} remote directory, {image} image tag; the skill fills only these three, no other placeholders. It never touches the live directory or the live image tag; without this block the gate is reported as 'not run'. Commands run on the remote machine via `ssh <remote> '<command>'`.
$comment_unit_env: Per-test environment variables (K46): if unit_test loops over test files one by one, give the env inside the command with `case $t in <test>) env="-e K=V -e K2=V2";; *) env="";; esac` and write `docker run ... $env ...`; no separate field or placeholder, the command runs under ssh as is. Example: "cd {dir} && rc=0; for f in tests/*_unit.py; do t=$(basename $f .py); case $t in session_unit) env=\"-e PORTAL_MODE=admin -e ADMIN_PUBLIC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8200\";; *) env=\"\";; esac; echo \"=== $t\"; docker run --rm -e PORTAL_SECRET=test $env -v $PWD/tests:/tests:ro {image} python -I /tests/$t.py || rc=1; done; exit $rc". Keep the env identical to the project's own test script (e.g. run_all.sh); a missing env turns a test red regardless of the patch (LLMPortal session_unit 4/8 → 8/8, K45 side finding 3).
